title: Swing–stride coupling does not improve the primary cross-dataset Parkinson gait classifier: a sensitivity-dependent public-data result
abstract: Within-foot swing–stride rank coupling was tested beyond mean stride, stride CV, mean swing fraction and swing CV. A fixed logistic model trained on 31 gaitndd participants was evaluated on 162 gaitpdb participants. Adding coupling changed external AUC from 0.7310 to 0.7277 (paired bootstrap difference -0.0033, 95% interval -0.0064 to -0.0006) and worsened log loss by 0.0130. The proposed lower coupling in PD was absent in both datasets. First60-cycle and demographic-adjustment sensitivities reversed incremental performance, precluding a universal no-utility conclusion or robust biomarker claim. Computation was isolated and the corrected pipeline clean-rerun; source overlap cannot be definitively excluded.
